summary: Build Brent and WTI forecasts, test scenarios, and report assumptions in Excel. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Oil price forecasting training helps energy analysts, economists, traders, procurement specialists, and risk professionals build crude-price outlooks for planning decisions. Participants work with Brent and WTI benchmarks and futures curves, prepare price data, and apply regression and ARIMA methods to create and compare forecasts. They also evaluate forecast errors, test economic scenarios, and communicate assumptions and uncertainty through Excel-based dashboards and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who analyze crude markets or use price outlooks in energy decisions. It suits intermediate learners with practical exposure to market, economic, procurement, or planning data.
modules: World Bank Data and Price Measurement
prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil or energy markets, business forecasting, or economic data is recommended. You should be comfortable using spreadsheet formulas and charts. No programming is required; advanced methods such as VAR, GARCH, and AI-assisted forecasting are introduced conceptually or through interpretation rather than implementation.
